Chopin Competition 2026-2027

The piano competition for students of UNIL/EPFL, UZH/ETH and UNIGE

Register

Who can take part?

The competition is open to Bachelor, Master and PhD students of UNIL/EPFL, UZH/ETH and UNIGE. When you register, you choose the campus (Lausanne, Zürich or Geneva) where you will take the first and second rounds. For example, an ETH exchange student studying in Lausanne can take the rounds in Lausanne. This choice is final.

How it works

1. First round: video

Send a video of yourself playing a piece by Chopin of your choice (5 to 15 minutes). Based on these videos, 30 people (across all campuses) are selected for the second round. The person who registers must be the person playing in the video.

  • Registration: until 30 November 2026
  • Video submission: until 31 December 2026 at midnight

2. Second round: local final in front of a jury

A local final takes place in each school (EPFL/UNIL, UZH/ETH and UNIGE) at the end of February 2027 (exact date to be confirmed). You play a programme of at least 10 minutes including at least one composition by Chopin; other pieces can be by any composer. This is the programme you will play at the Grand Final if selected. Results are announced one week after the end of the second round: 6 to 8 people are selected for the Grand Final.

3. Inter-school Grand Final in Lausanne

On 24 May 2027, in a concert hall, in public and in front of a jury of musicians. Finalists play their second-round programme (any change must be submitted to the jury in advance) and must arrive at least one hour before their performance. The evening is filmed: taking part in the final means you agree to your performance being posted on YouTube and social media.

A recording problem prevents you from meeting a deadline? Contact us before it at chopin.concours@gmail.com and we will find a solution.
